title: Market map
summary: Builds a competitor map, positioning summary, and opportunity framing from public company signals.
defaultObjective: Understand the company, the market, and the clearest opportunities without waiting on private systems.

title: GTM sweep
summary: Maps ICP, demand channels, offer positioning, and likely outbound/content motions.
defaultObjective: Identify the strongest growth motions and which channels the PM should activate first.

title: Content engine
summary: Generates a content and SEO backlog from public pages, positioning, and buyer intent signals.
defaultObjective: Turn public web signals into a durable content and SEO execution backlog.

title: Support and ops audit
summary: Reviews support surface, FAQ gaps, customer journey friction, and likely operational bottlenecks.
defaultObjective: Find the highest-leverage support and operational improvements from public evidence.

title: Automation blueprint
summary: Designs automation, instrumentation, and systems changes that would unlock scale for the business.
defaultObjective: Translate business needs into technical automations and implementation plans.

title: Company OS foundations
summary: Seeds the PM-led org, connector roadmap, and operating cadences for a new company in CC.
defaultObjective: Create the PM-led AI company, its first workstreams, and the next connector unlocks.

title: Customer ops playbook
summary: Turns support, onboarding, and recurring operational needs into automatable workflows for the PM.
defaultObjective: Design customer operations systems the PM can run without leaning on the owner.

title: Recruiting radar
summary: Uses public hiring signals and career pages to spot recruiting gaps, hiring plans, and operator needs.
defaultObjective: Identify hiring priorities and recruiting process gaps from public evidence.
